title: Inside a Rohingya Camp After a Genocide Ruling
summary: On Thursday, the International Court of Justice ruled that the atrocities against the Rohingya ethnic minority constituted a genocide waged by the Myanmar state. Before the decision, Hannah Beech, a New York Times correspondent, spent a week in the refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, home to at least 1.2 million Rohingya.
